title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24406v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. translated_title: CaDO：形式化验证引导的因果数据集修复与生成多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 高质量的因果推理数据集对于开发具有可靠因果理解能力的模型至关重要，尤其是在专业领域。然而，现有数据集经常存在标注错误和结构不平衡的问题，这可能导致有偏见的预测和有限的泛化能力。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了CaDO（因果引擎引导的多智能体数据优化），一个用于因果推理数据集自动诊断与修复的多智能体框架。我们的框架包含三个关键阶段：形式化因果推理、多层级诊断，以及自动化数据修复与生成。首先，形式化智能体将自然语言问题转化为形式化因果查询，以最小化语义偏差，并使检索和验证更加明确且易于处理。其次，双层诊断机制采用独立的批评智能体来识别样本级错误，同时对查询类型进行分析（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出CaDO多智能体框架，通过形式化因果推理、双层诊断与自动化数据修复三个阶段，自动诊断并修复因果推理数据集中的标注错误与结构不平衡问题。
en_tdlr: CaDO is a formal verification-guided multi-agent framework that automatically diagnoses and repairs causal reasoning datasets through formal causal reasoning, dual-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation.
